# pvecli pool content

Manage pool members (VMs/CTs).

## add

Add one or more VMs or Containers to a pool.

By default, adding a VM/CT that is already in another pool will fail.
Use --force to allow moving it from its current pool.

```text
pvecli pool content add [POOLID] [VMIDS] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `POOLID` | Pool ID. |
| `VMIDS` | VM or Container ID(s) (comma-separated, e.g. 100,101,102). |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-f`, `--force` | Allow moving VM/CT from another pool. |

## remove

Remove one or more VMs or Containers from a pool.

```text
pvecli pool content remove [POOLID] [VMIDS] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `POOLID` | Pool ID. |
| `VMIDS` | VM or Container ID(s) (comma-separated, e.g. 100,101,102). |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
